E - R conceptual model. Limitations for relations defined in DBS.

Architectures of Database System Management in personal computers. Systems, „client/server“.
Data-base application program languages. Structured language - SQL.
Programming in the system MS Access.
Programming in the system of ORACLE-type..
Data-based and Knowledge-Based systems. Operations with knowledge. Decision and, Control paradigms. Operations with uncertainties. Theory of fuzzy sets.
Operations with fuzzy sets. Fuzzy numbers and computing with fuzzy numbers., Linguistic variable.
Fuzzy logic. Compositional rule and fuzzy inference. Types of fuzzy implications and, their properties.
Types and kinds of knowledge representation. Expert system - modular structure., Inference engine and its co-operations with knowledge-base. System ETS.
Expert systems - examples (FELExpert, TRACER, XCON/XSELL, KEE, NEST,, G2).
Future of database and knowledge systems. Conclusions of lectures.
